raw_blocks: Data & AI Services Offerings
Integrated enterprise solutions help you harness the power of data and artificial intelligence.
Our Data & AI Services Offerings are built to solve distinct enterprise challenges from the real world.

Created from a base of five core pillars, together they cover the full lifecycle — from modernizing legacy foundations to running autonomous, AI-powered operations — with EPAM’s leading AI methodologies and solutions, like AI/Run™.Transform and migVisor™.
Migrate to modern, cloud-native data foundations fast with AI acceleration.
Deliver enterprise-scale, end-to-end AI platform strategy, governance and solutions.
Weeks to proof of value
Transform fragmented analytics into unified, AI-native decision systems.
Redesign operations and deploy intelligent agents that reason, decide and act.
Data & AI Managed Services
Stabilize, optimize and continuously transform with engineering-led services.
Build and transform your operations so you can protect your business, avoid conflicts of interest, retain full IP ownership and eliminate knowledge bleed to competitors.
Our extensive relationships with trusted global leaders and dedicated platform and solutions experts enable us to offer the best recommendations for your business goals.

With proven modernization programs and AI implementations as well as deep vertical expertise across regulated industries, we develop solutions tailored to your needs, using our methodologies and proprietary solutions.

Agent capability improvement by year two
